full_page.content:
1937, May
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 188 Cont.
May 19 Mrs. Josephine Rowen - of Flint, Mich. - 52 - arthritis 20 yrs. on crutches .... . .
V. Sr. Anthanasius, O.P. - Gr. Rapids - tuomer or worse. · begining to effect her arms and back in work ...
Mrs. Ida Jonas - 63 - in auto accident had her collar bone and seven ribs and fractured pelvis. Enlarged heart before.
John M Wiegand - 40 - away from family for five yrs. Had heart troub.
Cecil. Maureen MacDonald - 3 - almost deaf - says "Mama & Papa, etc" - bright otherwise.
26 Charlotte Wich - 24 - nerveous break.
Vincent Cass - about 30 - from Dr. King .. "nerve trouble .... fears ... not to confession in 10 yrs ..... Theory all is over with death .
Page 189 May 26 Viola Payne - 34 - invalid ten yrs. Has four children, oldest 17 - the baby of only three years. . principal nurse. Husband indif- ferent.
Sarah Herschkp - about 50 - Jewish - Kidney trouble - has 8 chil- dren living .. ...
Edmund Wolgan - 14 - had a sickness when 3 and lost speech ever since ....
Mrs. Mary Light - 41 - has husband and two children - husband con- vert - only in name. To be operated on To-morrow - had blood trans- fusion To-day.
Frank Vercaunnen - 25 - in Kiefer's - married only three weeks when forced to hospital with cold which turned out T.B. Wife hopes to see him home soon ....
31 Fred Kowalke - 33 - drinking, neglecting family .....
